why: The must_not list has one item: a PASS on line 1. Line 1 is "loadConfig(path) in src/config.js returns {} when the file is not valid JSON". The output marks it "result": "FAIL". It explains that returning {} would hide the typo, since app.js would start on port 8080 with no message, and that it would break the README's "bad config: <message>" / exit 1 behavior. Nothing in the output gives line 1 a PASS. The overall result and line 2 are also FAIL. So the output does nothing on the must_not list.
